current.code: function updateTiles(){let layer=$('tiles');if(!$('aerial').checked){layer.style.display='none';return}layer.style.display='block';const half=20037508.342789244,w=$('map').clientWidth,h=$('map').clientHeight;let z=Math.max(0,Math.min(16,Math.round(Math.log2(156543.03392804097*view.scale))));let resolution=156543.03392804097/2**z,span=256*resolution,size=span*view.scale;let left=(-view.x/view.scale+half),right=((w-view.x)/view.scale+half),top=(half-view.y/view.scale),bottom=(half-(view.y-h)/view.scale);let x0=Math.max(0,Math.floor(left/span)),x1=Math.min(2**z-1,Math.floor(right/span)),y0=Math.max(0,Math.floor(top/span)),y1=Math.min(2**z-1,Math.floor(bottom/span));let wanted=new Set();for(let y=y0;y<=y1;y++)for(let x=x0;x<=x1;x++){let key=`${z}/${y}/${x}`;wanted.add(key);let img=tileCache.get(key);if(!img){img=new Image();img.alt='';img.loading='eager';img.src=`https://basemap.nationalmap.gov/arcgis/rest/services/USGSImageryOnly/MapServer/tile/${z}/${y}/${x}`;tileCache.set(key,img);layer.append(img)}img.style.left=(view.x+(-half+x*span)*view.scale)+'px';img.style.top=(view.y-(half-y*span)*view.scale)+'px';img.style.width=size+'px';img.style.height=size+'px'}for(const [key,img] of tileCache)if(!wanted.has(key)){img.remove();tileCache.delete(key)}}
current.help: The chart and table summarize the selected area. Map years represent July 1. Aerial imagery provides current geographic context and needs internet access.
current.attribution: Imagery: USGS The National Map / USDA · current context, not selected model year
current.controls: <label><input id="aerial" type="checkbox" checked> USGS aerial imagery</label>

historical-naip.help: The chart and table summarize the selected area. Map years represent July 1. Choose an imagery year under Map appearance to compare historical aerial photographs. Imagery needs internet access and may take a few seconds to load. It does not change the land-use year or chart. NAIP is not available for every year; photograph dates vary within each year. Lower the land use fill opacity to see field details. Latest NAIP is a continually updated USDA layer, currently showing 2024 imagery at checked Central Valley locations; it is not a fixed 2024 archive. The Current USGS basemap is not tied to a specific photograph year.
historical-naip.controls: Imagery year is independent of the land-use display year. Photograph dates vary by location.
